verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs claim "Automatic HTTPS" (netlify-docs-9). A community user confirms free hosting with "custom domains with SSL" (netlify-comm-8), and another reports that cert errors on a free site were fixed by support (netlify-comm-6), so the core of automatic TLS on custom domains is evidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of wildcard certificate support, explicit documentation of automatic renewal, first-party confirmation that certificates are free on all plans, and coverage for every domain on a project.
